questions.q: On which day of the week was the Prophet SAW born?
questions.explain: The day of his birth and the day of the first revelation was Monday.

questions.q: According to the strongest report, how long after the attack of the army with elephants was the Prophet SAW born?
questions.explain: He was born about fifty days after that event, and that year is called the Year of the Elephant.

questions.q: Who chose 9 Rabi' al-Awwal based on astronomers' calculation?
questions.explain: Ibn Ishaq chose 12 Rabi' al-Awwal without a chain, while Al-Mubarakfuri chose 9.

questions.q: What did Umar Al-Khattab choose as the start of the Islamic calendar instead of the Prophet's birth year?
options: The year of the first revelation
The year of the conquest of Makkah
questions.explain: Umar chose the Hijrah as the start of the calendar.

questions.q: Who took the Prophet SAW to the Kaaba, prayed and named him Muhammad?
questions.explain: Abdul Muttalib named him Muhammad so that he would always be praised.

questions.q: When someone changes a name, whose name may be changed?
options: Only his own name, so that lineage can be traced
questions.explain: Change your own name, not your father's, to preserve lineage.

options: A name for the Year of the Elephant
A sacrifice on the birth of a child
questions.explain: According to the sirah record, Abdul Muttalib circumcised, named and performed the aqiqah for him.

questions.q: The exact date of the Prophet's SAW birth affects one's creed.
questions.explain: False. The Prophet never stated his birth date and creed does not depend on it.

questions.q: We can fully believe in prophethood without miraculous tales that have no source.
questions.explain: True. Unsourced miraculous stories are not needed for faith.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The Prophet SAW is born on a Monday
He is circumcised and the aqiqah is performed

questions.explain: Abdullah married, died, the Prophet SAW was born, named Muhammad, and then circumcised with the aqiqah.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The chain of narrators of a report
The traits and character of the Prophet SAW
The year of the elephant army's attack and the Prophet's birth

questions.explain: The Year of the Elephant is the birth year, mawlid is the birthday celebration, isnad is the chain of narrators and shama'il are the Prophet's traits and character.

questions.q: There are differing views on celebrating the mawlid. What attitude does this lecture teach?
options: Focus on what is more productive
questions.explain: Instead of heated arguments, focus on what is more productive.
